# Municipal Ordinance No. 13, Series of 2017

**An Ordinance Authorizing the Municipal Mayor and/or the Presiding Officer of the Sanggunian to Use Savings for Augmentation in Accordance with the Local Government Code of 1991**

## Summary

Authorizes the [[Municipal Mayor]] and/or the Presiding Officer of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] to use savings for augmentation of budget items in accordance with [[Sec-336-RA7160]] of the Local Government Code of 1991. Similar in substance to [[MO-11-S2018]].

Absent during session: [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] (on leave).

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1 (Use of Savings/Augmentation):** Authorizes the Municipal Mayor and/or Presiding Officer to augment items in the approved annual budget using savings from other items
- **Section 2 (Priority in Use of Personal Services Savings):** Establishes priority order for the utilization of savings from Personal Services

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] — absent (on leave)
- [[Paulino S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
- [[Municipal Budget Office]]

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-336-RA7160]] — Use of appropriated funds and savings
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, functions of the Sangguniang Bayan
